evals.prompt: Build me a landing page for Ledgerly, a B2B accounting automation platform for mid-size companies. It syncs with ERPs and closes the books automatically. Save it as a single HTML file.
evals.expected_output: A Stripe/Linear-style minimal landing page: light, typography-driven, one accent color, full anatomy from nav to footer.
assertions: No placeholder content: the HTML contains no 'lorem ipsum', 'Your Company', 'John Doe', or '[placeholder]' text
Self-contained single file: no external http(s) scripts, stylesheets, fonts, or images are referenced
Basic page hygiene: has a <title>, a meta viewport tag, and a favicon
Responsive design present: CSS uses media queries and/or clamp() for fluid sizing, and the layout adapts at mobile widths
No emoji used as feature icons anywhere in the page body
Interactive polish: CSS defines :hover states for buttons/links and respects prefers-reduced-motion
Complete page anatomy: page includes a nav, a hero section, at least two feature sections, a call-to-action section, and a multi-column footer
